text: rachel: quick thread on dark theme tweaks before the next release. main asks: 1) syntax highlighting across JS/Python snippets, 2) small-multiple charts (we need consistent line vs area semantics), 3) a couple copy nits in the dashboard header. tom: cool. paste current tokens so we can compare. priya: also flag: inline code vs code-block looks inconsistent on mobile; block padding + bg need a revisit. rachel: current vars: ``` --bg: #07090b --panel: #0e1013 --panel-2: #131417 --muted-1: #95a0a7 --accent-cool: #7ec3ff --accent-warm: #ff9aa2 --code-bg: #0b0d0f --code-fg: #dfeaf6 --code-keyword: #9fd5ff --code-string: #a6e3b3 ``` ben: `code-fg` on `code-bg` is around 4.3:1 per usual checks. contrast-bot will throw a warning for normal-weight inline spans. contrast-bot: auto-report: `#dfeaf6` on `#0b0d0f` => 4.3:1 (recommend >=4.5 for body text). priya: proposal: keep block bg dark (#0b0d0f) but set inline token fg to `#eaf6ff` (4.6:1), and for code blocks slightly lift bg to `#0f1113` so long examples read better. tom: for syntax themes across languages, let's map semantics not just colors: keywords, types, strings, builtins. make keywords slightly saturated cool, types more muted warm, strings saturated warm. that helps scanning. ben: chart semantics: we should reserve high-chroma for strokes in small-multiples. proposal: lines use `--line-1: #6fb8ff`, `--line-2: #7ee0b2`, `--line-3: #ffb59a` with 1px outer halo `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` when on panel-2. area fills stay low-opacity 0.16 of same hue. priya: pattern note: for accessibility, error-series should use dashed pattern + warm hue. do not rely on hue alone. rachel: copy nit: header shows "Live" badge with tooltip "Live updates" 0 can we change tooltip to "Live updates: real-time metrics (may be approximate)"? small but useful. tom: +1. also in settings the debug toggle says "Verbose logs" 0 change to "Verbose logs (may include sensitive tokens)"? maybe too scary. maybe "may include request details". ben: small CSS snippet to test inline token: ``` const x = 42 ``` contrast-bot: reminder: run `design-kit color-a11y --threshold 4.5` after changes. priya: action items: 1) rachel to update copy strings and push to i18n (today). 2) tom to export language token map + palette adjustments (mock by tomorrow). 3) ben to generate chart small-multiple prototypes with halo + patterns (EOD). 4) priya to test mobile code block spacing. rachel: thanks all 0 will follow up here with updated token snapshot and the i18n PR link. :rocket:
